== Notes ==

* Posted 'TDIGWATT' dested This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further; 'Cloud City: Carbonate Chamber' Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber.
* Dark Deal (unique) posted x2; dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

Here is how this works.  Draw hand and deploy all sites.  Search reserve deck and take both bespin or Cloud City and Executor into hand.  If you have three Cloud City Cites down then save the force.  If not, you should keep picking up force until you get them.  Deploy executor and at least one pilot for a destiny draw, and add capitals as needed.  Cloud Combat Cars, Black two, and Slave I defend cloud city.  While Cloud City Troopers, Bounty hunters, and several picked characters defend the ground.  Just get Dark Deal out as soon as possible for the drain and added power.  My bounty hunters have so much going for them. They got Double back for quick retrieval from lost pile and reserve deck.  Hidden Weapons is sweat for taking out very pesky characters.  He’s all yours bounty hunter helps out a bit, but I my trade in other cards for at least one of them.  Also my guns can be forfeited to used pile plus alleviate some damage.  Not to mention hurt mangle and decimate my opponents.  Any Help would be appreciated.  Thank you.
